title: docs(skills): `skills/objectui/guides/app-composition.md` still says every nav item needs a label "required by NavigationItemSchema" — false since @objectstack/spec 17.5.0 and objectui#9868 (label absent ⇒ inherited)
body:
Filing-gate category: ② a governed-text defect: a published instruction that a landed change made false. `reach:` the governed instructions file that AI authors read when composing an app.

- **The sentence**, in `skills/objectui/guides/app-composition.md`: 「Every nav item needs a snake_case id and a label (both required by NavigationItemSchema)」.
- **Why it is now false:**
  - `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 makes `NavigationItemSchema.label` optional, with the declared semantic "absent ⇒ the entry inherits its target's CURRENT label at render time; present ⇒ verbatim" (maintainer ruling A `5731297631`, via objectstack-ai/objectstack#19049).
  - objectui's validator relaxes to match in PR objectui#11186 (objectui#9868).
  - Once that PR lands, an AI following the guide writes a label it does not need, and loses the inheritance the ruling exists for: a renamed target no longer renames its nav entry.
- **Why it is not in PR objectui#11186:** `skills/**` is governed (Tier H, maintainer approval). A governed hunk would turn the p2 `pm:blocking` PR into a wait for approval and delay cloud#2021, and it was outside that claim's fence. The contract review agreed it belongs in a separate governed PR.

Reader: triage first (grade and route; `domain:skills`). Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`) at the ACCEPT of PR objectui#11186, from `out_of_scope_findings[1]` (`5908597262`). ⛔ Not graded here.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- A one-sentence, skills-only governed PR: the id is required; the label is optional, and when it is absent the entry shows its target's current label. It may also name when an author label is still right (a deliberate nav-only name).
- It can ride objectui#11183 (the governed `action:*` taught-docs migration, `domain:skills`) if its seat agrees, since both are governed taught-doc corrections. ⛔ Otherwise a separate PR.
- Order: after PR objectui#11186 lands, so the guide never runs ahead of the validator.
